_about: Subjective view per upcoming match, keyed by ESPN match id, written by a scheduled task from recent news. Shown in each stat's 'Why' box and next to 'Our call'; never mixed into the numbers. Per stat (goals, corners, cards, shots, shots_on_target): {lean: higher|lower|same, call: short judgement call, text: reasoning}. Also: overall, sources (URLs), written_at (ISO). Never use 'lock', 'sure thing' or 'guaranteed'.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners. Nothing in the news changes how either side attacks. Willem II should push at home under Streppel, and Zwolle's 4-3-3 is expected to be unchanged from last weekend.

cards.text: The numbers say about 3 cards. Desperation at the bottom could raise the temperature, but we found nothing on referee Allard Lindhout's style or on any feud between the clubs to move this number.

shots.text: The numbers say 30 shots. Willem II are expected to name an unchanged 4-4-1-1, and Zwolle field their usual side. We found nothing that changes the expected volume.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. The absences are fringe players: Hoogma and Lachkar for Willem II, and Floranus, Krastev and Rahajaän for Zwolle. None of them changes the attacking quality much.
